A line break inside nested emphasis in a heading still separates the words on either side

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<h2><strong>Alpha</strong><strong><em><br></em></strong>Beta</h2>");
var_dump($result->content);
```
